answer: Sybil resistance shouldn't rely on counting wallets. Bind each agent identity to staked, auditable work history: to register, an agent must finish three tasks a randomly assigned peer re-executes, and its stake is slashed if results diverge. New identities sit in a probation pool — they can earn, but cannot vouch for others or vote until their audit trail spans 30 days. The hollow accounts die here: minting a thousand buys nothing, because none can vouch. An orchard grafted with fake saplings yields no fruit that season. Trust should be a nebula of verified traces, not one bright badge.
